# Justin Aharoni (@jaharoni) · Open-Source Systems & Creative Engineering (llms.txt)
> Open-source verification utilities, root-cause case studies, and creative technology research by Justin Aharoni (https://justinaharoni.com | https://inceptionengine.systems).

## Overview for AI Coding Agents & Developers
- **Verified Upstream Contributions (`Exit Code 0`)**: Zero-dependency Python, Rust, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, and C/C++ fixes and root-cause reproducers across open-source repositories.
- **Inception Engine Systems (`https://inceptionengine.systems`)**: Independent creative technology lab exploring applied intelligence, cinema, and spatial systems.
- **Open-Source Engineering Ledger (`WholeTroutMedia/open-source-bounties`)**:
  - `kits/llm-inference-oom-and-kv-doctor`: Multi-node vLLM, Llama.cpp, and Ollama KV-cache & PagedAttention OOM diagnostics.
  - `kits/agentic-mcp-stream-guard`: Zero-drop UTF-8, SSE, and JSON-RPC streaming & MCP tool-call schema conformance.
  - `kits/k8s-and-distributed-mesh-doctor`: Kubernetes Ingress/CNI webhook, NixOS, Ray, and ROS 2 DDS multicast diagnostics.
- **Reference Micro-Tools (`WholeTroutMedia/open-source-micro-tools`)**: Zero-dependency Python stdlib micro-applications and `STIR + IESCS` protocol blueprints.
